QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Heart-Stopping Confession on the Swingboat
QuestInfo.1: #bDylan#k couldn't work up the courage to profess his love on the Gyro Drop, so he insists on riding the Swingboat.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at the Swingboat in #bFantasy Station <2>#k.

2.msg: #b(It looks like Dylan was still too nervous to say anything.)#k

3.msg: So, that was the Gyro Drop! It was even more amazing and thrilling than I'd heard! Amazing! It was such a sudden drop, I couldn't even breathe, let alone speak!

4.msg: #b(You take in a few big gulps of air after the wild ride. Dylan takes no notice.)#k

5.msg: All that's left is the exhilarating #bSwingboat#k! I'll definitely confess there! It couldn't be a better place!

no.0: You were scared of the Gyro Drop too? I'll wait for you. I'm feeling a bit... blaaargh!
